feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The best raced design is iteration 6 (score 683.7): base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, kd 0.5, sensors at y 0.07, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss last_direction. Iteration 7 (base_speed 0.85, score 679.8) finished 20/20 on the oval and s-bend, but slalom progress was 0.364 against 0.392 at base_speed 0.9, so 0.9 is the best measured speed for the slalom. Iteration 5 (y 0.05 to 0.07 at base 1.0) showed that lead improved the s-bend (finishes 15 to 19 of 20, oscillation 0.38 to 0.32) and left the slalom at about 0.31. This candidate is a single-variable step from the best design: it keeps iteration 6's controller and moves the sensors from y 0.07 to y 0.075. The gain is expected to be small, and the slalom remains the limiting track. The off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + 0.12/4) = 0.06 m, and widening the body cannot raise it above 0.0575 m. The candidate is valid and at least as plausible as the best design, so approve it to race. After the race, read it as follows. If s-bend finishes hold at 19 to 20 of 20 with oscillation under about 0.4, and the slalom progress is at or above 0.39, keep y 0.075. If s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20 or s-bend steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.5, return the sensors to y 0.07. If the slalom stays near 0.39 with low oscillation, the next lever is kd 0.6 at base_speed 0.9, not further speed reduction, because base_speed 0.85 already showed that speed no longer helps.
requested_changes: Keep base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, kd 0.5 and line_loss last_direction as in iteration 6. Move all five sensors to y 0.075 and keep the x positions and 16 mm footprints, since iteration 5 showed lead helped the s-bend without moving the slalom.
If s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20 or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.5, return the sensors to y 0.07. Iteration 5 showed the s-bend tolerated y 0.07 with 19 of 20 finishes.

If slalom progress stays near 0.39 with low oscillation, test kd 0.6 at base_speed 0.9 with the sensors at the better of y 0.07 or 0.075. Iteration 7 showed that base_speed 0.85 reduced slalom progress to 0.364, so speed is no longer the lever.
